## Purpose / root cause

What problem is this change solving? Distinguish the observed problem from the proposed cause.

## Scope

What changed? What was deliberately left alone?

## Evidence / verification

What proves the change works? Include the exact command, test, measurement, screenshot, or manual check that matters.

- [ ] Targeted verification completed
- [ ] Relevant broader checks completed
- [ ] Visual/runtime result inspected when applicable
- [ ] No unrelated files or behavior changed

## Risk / revert

What could regress? How can this change be reverted safely?

## Historical context

Link only the specific prior decision, handoff section, issue, or experiment that matters. Do not paste an entire historical record into the PR.
